*Kusalattika, Niyyānikaduka* (Patthana 22.13) is a canonical Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Structurally, it treats the intersection of the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) with the dyad of factors leading to emancipation (*niyyānikaduka*) through the Paṭṭhāna's formal matrix of conditional relations.

 Computational analysis by DharmaNexus shows extensive internal Pali text reuse characteristic of the combinatorial structure of the *Paṭṭhāna*, identifying 119 matching passages across 38 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus records no cross-language matches in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan corpora [DharmaNexus].
